text:
julian: Heads-up — planning a manifest swap + deploybot throttle during the Private/VPC delivery window tonight 23:00-23:45 UTC. Intend to swap sealed-manifest v2026.03.21-rc1 -> v2026.03.21. Canary 5m, then gradual fanout. Need signoff on signer, checksums, and rollback criteria before I kick off.

marta: Quick Q — have we rotated the cosign key for the new manifest? KMS signer expiry was bumped last week, want to confirm TTL. Also any change to the submanifest ordering?

ops-deploy-bot: deploybot: planned concurrency cap = 8 hosts, throttle window enabled, backoff policy = exponential up to 10m. Auto-abort if sustained failure rate > 5% for 15m. Dry-run supported with --dry-run flag.

dan: Adding release-notes: please include the private-installer delta summary and the {breaking change: config schema 2.4} note. I'll prepare the short blurb; where do we attach? (manifest or repo tag?)

build: Uploaded artifacts to staging-bucket. Checksums: sha256=3a7f...c9e1. Cosign sig present. Verify commands I ran:
```
sha256sum sealed-manifest-v20260321.tar.gz
# output: 3a7f...c9e1  sealed-manifest-v20260321.tar.gz
cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/installer-signer sealed-manifest-v20260321.tar.gz
# output: Verified OK
```
All artifact hashes and cosign metadata in s3://redwood-private/releases/20260321/.

aisha: Rollback criteria proposal: abort and pin back to v2026.03.17 if ANY of: canary error rate >= 2% (5m window), OR >=3 hosts fail to apply the delta, OR manifest validation mismatch on >1 region. Also if p95 latencies for installer RPCs jump > 2x baseline. If abort, run: `deploybot rollback --manifest sealed-v20260317 --reason "canary-fail"` and open immediate pager.

marta: Confirmed KMS signer TTL is good, cosign key not rotated since 2026-03-14. I'll monitor signer logs during swap and stand by for manual cosign reissue if verification fails.

julian: Thanks — plan: dry-run at 22:30 UTC (no live swap), quick smoke, then actual swap at 23:00 UTC with throttle on. @marta @aisha @dan please be oncall 22:30-00:00 UTC. I'll post the deploybot command and manifest diff in this thread right before dry-run.

dan: I'll post the release note blurb in the release-notes doc and tag the manifest SHA. Linking doc: https://handbook.internal/release-notes/private/2026-03-21

ops-deploy-bot: deploybot: sample command for the run (dry-run):
```
deploybot swap-manifest --from sealed-v20260321-rc1 --to sealed-v20260321 --concurrency 8 --canary 5m --throttle --dry-run
```
When ready omit --dry-run. Watch deploybot logs at https://deploybot.redwood.internal/logs/1719991234.

build: One more check — migration table included in manifest? Confirmed yes (migrations/v2-to-v2.4.sql included). If rollback, migration reversal script exists but untested against latest airgap chain; flagging risk.

aisha: Acknowledged risk. If rollback required, we'll prioritize abort + pin rather than trying partial reverse migrations. Good to have the reversal script as fallback but not part of the immediate rollback plan.

julian: All agreed. I'll spawn the dry-run at 22:30 and report back with smoke results. If anyone sees unexpected failures during canary, call the pager immediately and mark the thread with :rotating_light:.

marta: :thumbsup: standing by.

aisha: Oncall and monitoring dashboards up (private-installer/canary).

julian: Final note — update CHANGELOG with small note about packaging fix for airgap metadata order. I'll add the release note before swap.
